provinceDeepAtlasProfile.oneLine: Kaelvorrin is centered at 6.383293, 5.827743 under Consensus Democracy, with 133,180,000 people across 9 settlements.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Kaelvorrin occupies 5,610,032.72 sq mi / 14,529,918.04 sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory, about 2.848636% of Belavadös's surface. It is not merely a province but a continent-scale civic machine: Farming, Partial forest and Grassland define its broad terrain, while its settlements intensify into Farming and Partial forest. Population density is 9.166 people/sq km / 23.740 people/sq mi, which lets wilderness, roads, faction-held corridors, and vast uncrowded borders remain huge.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.peopleFactionsAndFaith: The strongest public people-groups are Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, Halfling and Smallfolk, Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, Dwarven and Gnomish Kin, Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, Elf Parent Race and Elf Bloodlines, and 1 more. Frequently recorded peoples include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin, Harengon, Centaur, Giff, and 4 more. Faction visibility leans toward The Brass Concordat, with worship and patronage records naming Nebyrr, Ishtanora, Iskareth, Marduthor, Raeshkul, Bastveig, Sigrananna, and 3 more.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.groupLinkDescription: The province participates in 7 recorded four-province geography group links, including 5 cross-transportation-group links. These links place it inside overlapping regional corridors rather than one isolated block, allowing border-adjacent transit, faction influence, and cultural spillover to breathe across group lines.

npcs.name: Mason Roarbeast
npcs.description: Mason Roarbeast is a Shifter Pack boss who believes leadership belongs to whoever can survive being challenged in public. At the Thal'ryssun Guild Desk, he keeps Nefaric Veil fighters, beast-handlers, and territory crews loyal through dominance, spectacle, rewards, and the occasional bone-cracking reminder of hierarchy. He is crude, perceptive, and more politically aware than his animalistic theater suggests, especially when deciding whether a newcomer is prey, rival, or alpha material.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Thal'ryssûn is a Village in Kaelvorrin, under Consensus Democracy, with low danger, Farming, Partial forest, Deep forest terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin. Shifter reads through the Shifter entry of the race compendium, within Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, marked by Iskareth. Beast-touched humanoids capable of temporarily manifesting predatory traits such as claws, speed, or senses. They are driven by instinct but remain culturally grounded. Table cues: Bestial Instincts, Darkvision, Shifting; starting tendency Selfish - Lawful - Combative - Neutral.
rumors: Mason Roarbeast knows why an ichor ledger changed hands last Sigranday.
Mason Roarbeast has a contact in Mossvale who will deny everything.
plotHooks: Mason Roarbeast asks the party to protect a household member without revealing why.
A rival faction offers proof that Mason Roarbeast's public story is incomplete.
